records.title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships — Research Fellowship 2027–2028
records.summary: Full-time research in Switzerland for early-career researchers pursuing a PhD outside Switzerland. A Swiss academic supervisor and a detailed research plan are required. A master's degree or equivalent must be completed by 31 July 2027 (30 June 2027 for ETH Zurich). The 2027–2028 country list offers this scholarship type to applicants from Brazil.

records.title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships — PhD Scholarship 2027–2028
records.summary: Full-time PhD research at a Swiss university or recognised research institute. A Swiss academic supervisor, a detailed research plan and a master's degree or equivalent are required. The 2027–2028 country list offers this scholarship type to applicants from Brazil.
records.duration: 12 months; renewable twice up to 36 months, subject to academic progress
